name: 32202 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32202 (Jacksonville) has 211 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32202 (Jacksonville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32202 (Jacksonville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 56 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
